name: Price of Desires
source:
On their last day of a passionate tropical getaway, a couple with simmering desires are approached with a sinfully tempting offer: compete in a series of high-stakes games for a life-changing bounty. Deception, lust, and risky choices will decide whether they leave as winners… or destroy what they have forever.

[From [url=https://dogwalkergames.itch.io/price-of-desires]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在充满激情的热带度假的最后一天，一对渴望已久的夫妇收到了一个极具诱惑力的提议：参加一系列高风险的游戏，以获得改变生活的赏金。欺骗、欲望和冒险的选择将决定他们是作为胜利者离开……还是永远摧毁他们所拥有的一切。

[来自[url=https://dogwalkergames.itch.io/price-of-desires]itch.io[/url]]
